text:
incident-bot: ALERT: reserved-pool:spectralbank-resv UTIL=100% queue_len=1240 autoscaler=ERROR (max_nodes_reached)
ryan.oncall: ack — looking now. paging @ana for dedicated pool ops.
ana.ops: on it, pulling pool telemetry. can someone confirm which reservation id?
ryan.oncall: reservation id resv-97f4 (SpectralBank Prod). seeing 429/503s from their tenant. support notified? @katie.support
katie.support: support pinged customer via email + slack around 14:32 UTC. they report spike in embed calls and timeouts for batch endpoints. no PII exposure.
miguel.sre: grabbing autoscaler logs, `grep resv-97f4 /var/log/autoscaler/*.log` shows repeated attempts to scale but hit limit: "scale aborted: reached max_instances=12 for pool=dedicated-us-west2". Also bucket_queue_length for pool = 1.2k.
maya.eng-runtime: we have two levers: 1) evict lower-priority reservations (but enterprise reserved means we can't auto-evict), 2) enable fair-share throttling at routing layer, 3) manual burst-add (if capacity/quota allows).
nana.ops: quota is tight in us-west2 today — cloud provider shows 0 spare GPUs in our account. manual add will need approvals and likely take ~10-12m to provision.
elliot.sre: suggestion: apply temporary per-tenant request limit on spectralbank to protect platform. we can do that via routing API.
ryan.oncall: ok let's throttle SpectralBank to 25 rps for now and open a contingency to route non-latency-sensitive jobs to smaller model variant (gpt-small-quant).
maya.eng-runtime: command to apply rate limit (internal console):
```
POST /v1/pools/dedicated/route-policies
{
  "pool":"dedicated-us-west2",
  "tenant":"spectralbank",
  "policy":{
    "type":"leaky_bucket",
    "rps":25,
    "burst":50
  }
}
```
nana.ops: applying now. ETA for policy push ~10s.
nana.ops: policy pushed — routing confirms enforcement. current queue_len falling: 1240 -> 840 -> 410 (monitoring graph: https://grafana.internal/d/pool/dedicated-us-west2?panel=queue_len).
miguel.sre: autoscaler still logging "reach max_instances" but queue drain improving because requests are being tokenized at gateway. no more 503s in last 60s.
katie.support: communicated to SpectralBank: "We're throttling to protect platform while we add capacity; your traffic is being rate-limited to 25 rps. We'll follow up with timeline for scaling." They replied: "We can reduce non-essential batch jobs, sending ops team to coordinate"
spectralbank-bizops: thanks — we're pausing internal batch jobs, keeping critical user-facing traffic only. ETA 20m for batch pause.
ryan.oncall: opening escalation ticket for autoscaler limit behavior and noisy neighbor detection. assigning to eng-runtime + sres for follow-up post incident.
maya.eng-runtime: quick diagnostic snippet from router logs:
```
[2026-03-15T14:40:12Z] router: tenant=spectralbank id=req-87933 latency=980ms token=ok route_policy=enforced
[2026-03-15T14:41:44Z] router: tenant=other-tenant id=req-88512 latency=120ms token=ok
```
elliot.sre: follow-up immediate mitigation: requesting manual burst add (2x A100) — ops pls check provider spare capacity in same region.
nana.ops: provider quoted 2x A100 available but provisioning will take ~11m and requires billing approval. initiating purchase now.
miguel.sre: started capture of KV cache stats — SpectralBank prefix cache hit rate low (5%), large fanout of unique prompts — likely noisy neighbor behavior due to many unique requests causing KV churn. add to postmortem.
ryan.oncall: timeline so far: 14:32 ALARM -> 14:34 ack -> 14:36 throttle policy -> 14:45 queue draining started -> 14:52 provider provisioning requested.
katie.support: notifying account exec and sending status update to customer: "Throttling in effect, scaling requested. We'll confirm once capacity added and queues drained."
spectralbank-bizops: appreciate the quick action. any ETA for full restoration?
nana.ops: if provider provisioning succeeds, expect full relief ~12-15m after capacity becomes active and autoscaler rebalances. otherwise we maintain throttling + routing to smaller model.
miguel.sre: evidence snapshot for postmortem:
```
autoscaler.err: scale_attempt:2026-03-15T14:35:11 reason=max_nodes_reached pool=dedicated-us-west2 limit=12
router.warn: tenant_slowdown: spectralbank inflight=480 backlog=1240
```
ryan.oncall: good. I'll stay on until queues are back to <50 and SpectralBank confirms. tagging follow-ups: ENG_RUNTIME-345 (noisy-neighbor detector), SRE-298 (autoscaler max-instance safety), OPS-501 (burst-provision runbook).
resolution-note: 14:58 capacity added (2x A100), autoscaler rebalanced, queue drained to 18 by 15:05 UTC, spectralbank traffic returned to normal; we removed rate limit at 15:08. Customer impact: transient 503s and increased latencies for ~26 minutes affecting some user-facing requests and batch jobs that have since been paused.
post-action: scheduled a postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 PST. owners: maya.eng-runtime, miguel.sre, ana.ops.
ryan.oncall: closing handoff — moving to incident review. :white_check_mark:
